title: Beautyworld Dubai at 30: Star Power on the Show Floor
summary: Gulf brides who want the Hailey Bieber look, malls that outdraw America’s and a service culture that treats guests like royalty. Four of beauty’s biggest names reflect on what they saw at Beautyworld Dubai.
